_about: What is known about each revision beyond its files: made (JLCPCB's order, its date, and the commit it was made from, byte-matched to the export in git), drawn, never made, ordered, notes, tested, and the label each revision carries. Tools/revision-audit/register.py writes REVISIONS.md from it.

notes.COB|Keyboard Encoder Helper|1.0: to fit the COB plate, drill plate holes 9 and 21 out to 5 mm: see the README
notes.COB|CPU Card Pro|1.1: title block credits bahamutkotd, who contributed
notes.COB|Backplane Pro|1.0: the board's silk says 6502 BACKPLANE, its name when ordered

_labels: Tested, Proven design or Untested, with a one-line reason. A revision whose 'tested' entry starts with Yes is Tested unless it is listed here; every other revision must be listed. Tools/revision-audit/labels.py reads this for REVISIONS.md, BOM.md and the README.

_replaced: A made revision whose number a newer design took, by the owner's ruling (KICAD.md K39). Each entry keeps the made boards' JLCPCB order, its date, the commit they were made from, and the last commit that holds the made files; the revision itself is drawn, in 'drawn'. The tools treat it as drawn; register.py names the made boards in its notes.
